svg.text: Mockup 8 · the card in every state
A spine of tabs and one face. One heading. One action row: the main action a pill, the rest wells, Details always last.
No family, so no spine. Shown when nothing is selected.
Tabs down the spine: the planet, its station, its moons.
The Moons tab opens a list. The planet stays the face.
Same width. The tabs haven't moved. Headings meet.
Dimmed, with the reason under it.
Picked from the list. ‹ › step the moons.
No siege can take a moon's guns.
Tabs, the small card, then the pill and wells.

g.text: Tap the card to hold it up

svg.text: The list takes the right side.
Tabs are squares and actions are
round, so a way somewhere is never
The tabs and the action row keep
their places in every state, so nothing
